thread:
maria.devex: quick check — are we agreed on how cancellation/context should propagate across SDK bindings? noticed different behaviors between node/python/go on stream teardown :thinking:

dmitri.eng: Not fully aligned, yeah. Node uses AbortController, py uses a CancelScope/context manager pattern, go uses context.Context. main mismatch is when user cancels during streaming: who closes send vs recv and how we surface error.

essen.py: fwiw, python SDK currently raises a CancelledError immediately on user cancel, but the underlying transport sometimes keeps the http response open until server sends EOF. leads to lingering sockets.

ravi.go: Go side cancels ctx, but we rely on http2 stream cancel which sets RST_STREAM; server sometimes treats that as a client disconnect and leaves backend work running. Seen it with long-generation jobs.

dmitri.eng: We should pick a convention: on user cancel we should (1) cancel local streaming reader loop, (2) send a graceful cancel signal to server when supported, (3) if no graceful path, force close. Thoughts?

sophia.sre: Agree. Also add observability: metric for "client_cancelled_but_server_still_working" so we can detect leaks.

essen.py: Implementation note: python binding could add an explicit "signal" header when canceling so server can short-circuit. rough sketch:

```python
# pseudocode
with client.stream(..., timeout=None) as s:
    try:
        for chunk in s:
            handle(chunk)
    except CancelledError:
        # send a cancel flag to control plane/gateway
        gateway.notify_cancel(request_id)
        raise
```

ravi.go: For Go I'd do ctx cancellation + a small sidecar RPC to the gateway to mark job as cancelled. Want to avoid double-work if server already finished.

dmitri.eng: Can we standardize a small cancel handshake over our gateway: header x-rw-cancelable: true and then a cancel POST to /v1/cancel/<reqid>? That lets bindings do graceful abort across languages.

maria.devex: that sounds reasonable. who wants to sketch the API PR and the SDK changes? low priority but causing flaky leaks in prod tests.

essen.py: I can draft the python half (add header + notify_cancel). will open PR against SDK and notes for server change.

ravi.go: I'll do Go side next week. Heads up: need tests for http2 reset behavior.

dmitri.eng: I'll update node to call the cancel endpoint on AbortController.signal abort, and change streaming teardown to force-close the socket after a short backoff if cancel endpoint fails.

sophia.sre: Please include a unit/integration test that simulates a hung backend. we'll want an alert if the cancel path latency > 2s.

ci-bot: deploy-check: running go unit tests for repo/sdk-go — 3/42 passed, 39 skipped (flake?). see CI link: https://ci.internal/12345

maria.devex: thanks all. please tag me in the PRs and add a short note in the release checklist under "streaming cancel semantics". I'll schedule a 20m sync if needed. :thumbsup:
